code.noramp: O15 candidate scores and capped-width ranking, without the startup ramp
code.after: O15 as kept: candidate scores, capped-width ranking and startup ramp

environment.note: Fixed-maximum-order and backward-Euler rows do not use order selection and ran once, with the O15 code.

setup.ramp: test_kinetics_reference ramp (2x2 reflective, 1 group, 6 families, 0.2 s, reference Radau rtol 1e-12); adaptive monolithic step, initial dt 1e-4, multigroup rtol 1e-13, tol_step 1e-12, default controller. Driver: ramp_record.py.
setup.hpmr: examples/hpmr_bdf_cpu_benchmark.py case slow-symmetric: HP-MR 2-D refine 2, 11 groups, drums 150 -> 154 deg over 0.8 s in 4 control intervals, BDF restart at each knot; adaptive monolithic step from dt 0.1, min_dt 0.8/64/4096, max_dt 0.2, factor-two rejection. Reference: automatic BDF5 at rtol 1e-6 (78 steps). Error: max over accepted steps of |P/P_ref - 1| with P_ref interpolated linearly. Driver: hpmr.py.
setup.lra: run_lra2d_cpu(refine=1, implicit_feedback=True, thermal_zones='assembly'), automatic BDF5, initial dt 1e-6, min_dt 1e-7, max_dt 0.1, factor-two rejection. Reference values: benchmark-results/adaptive-bdf-error-norm/lra2d.json (automatic BDF5 at rtol 1e-7, blockwise). The peak is the largest accepted-step sample and scatters by several 1e-4 with step placement. Driver: lra.py.
